UPS's 2018 10-K reports more than 481,000 employees and headquarters in Atlanta. The grant EIN (36-2407381) is an operating UPS entity, not the Delaware parent's EIN (58-2480149); JobsOhio lists 1,799 jobs retained in Columbus.

General Aluminum Mfg. Company is listed as an Ohio subsidiary in Park-Ohio's 2020 10-K Exhibit 21; Park-Ohio reports about 6,500 employees worldwide and headquarters in Cleveland. JobsOhio lists 110 jobs retained at the Ravenna site.

Nidec Minster is part of Nidec Press & Automation (minster.com), owned by Kyoto-based Nidec Corporation, which reports about 100,000 employees (107,062 consolidated in 2017 per Wikipedia). Form 5500 shows 721 participants at the Minster entity in 2019.

Coty US LLC is listed in Coty Inc.'s FY2018 10-K Exhibit 21; Coty reported about 20,000 full-time employees and headquarters at 350 Fifth Avenue, New York. The Pataskala site is not named in the 10-K.

Formlabs Ohio Inc. is Spectra Photopolymers of Millbury, which Somerville, Mass.-based Formlabs announced it had acquired in November 2019; the Ohio unit had 36 to 59 Form 5500 participants. Wikipedia lists 750 Formlabs employees in 2026, and the 2019 worldwide count was not found, so the bucket for the first grant year is less certain.

New Hampshire Business Review reported in 2014 that Dover, N.H.-based ElectroCraft grew from 400 to 700 employees worldwide by buying Hansen Corp., with plants in Ohio, Arizona, Michigan and China. The Gallipolis unit had 135 Form 5500 participants in 2015; any owner above ElectroCraft, Inc. was not checked.
